card.name: Crude Bent Blade
card.oracleText:
When this Equipment enters, target opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
Equipped creature gets +2/+1.
Equip {2} ({2}: Attach to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.)

card.name: March of the Machines
card.oracleText: Each noncreature artifact is an artifact creature with power and toughness each equal to its mana value. (Equipment that's a creature can't equip a creature.)

card.name: The Collector
card.oracleText:
Whenever you cast a signed spell or play a signed land, copy it. (A signed card is a card signed by its artist, designer, or someone else it's strongly associated with.)
Discard a signed card: Destroy target creature with a name that has a five or fewer letter length difference from the person who signed the discarded card.

card.name: Fatal Push
card.oracleText:
Destroy target creature if it has mana value 2 or less.
Revolt — Destroy that creature if it has mana value 4 or less instead if a permanent left the battlefield under your control this turn.

card.name: Nexus of Fate
card.oracleText:
Take an extra turn after this one.
If Nexus of Fate would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, reveal Nexus of Fate and shuffle it into its owner's library instead.

card.name: Impossible Man
card.oracleText:
Flying
{2}{U}: Impossible Man becomes a copy of another target permanent until end of turn, except his name is Impossible Man.

card.name: Earthbending Student
card.oracleText:
When this creature enters, earthbend 2. (Target land you control becomes a 0/0 creature with haste that's still a land. Put two +1/+1 counters on it. When it dies or is exiled, return it to the battlefield tapped.)
Land creatures you control have vigilance. (Attacking doesn't cause them to tap.)

card.name: Land Station
card.oracleText:
When this Spacecraft enters, reveal a basic land card from outside the game and put it into your hand. (remembering that the nearest land station may be behind you).
Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 10+.)
10+ | Flying
This creature gets +1/+1 for each basic land you control.

card.name: Unstoppable Slasher
card.oracleText:
Deathtouch
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, they lose half their life, rounded up.
When this creature dies, if it had no counters on it, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control with two stun counters on it.

card.name: Unbreakable Formation
card.oracleText:
Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, put a +1/+1 counter on each of those creatures and they gain vigilance until end of turn.
